definitions.explanation: The area where visitors are received and directed.
The person who works at the reception desk.
The act of receiving applications, registrations, etc.

examples.japanese: {受付|うけつけ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あちら→あちら：00913_achira⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The reception desk is over there.

examples.japanese: {受付|うけつけ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please write your name at the reception desk.

⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あったら→ある：00006_aru⟧、{受付|うけつけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}けば→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦もらえる→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: If there's something you don't understand, you can ask the receptionist and they'll help you.

⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受付|うけつけ}⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{午前|ごぜん}→午前：00548_gozen⟧⟦{九時|くじ}→九時：10980_kuji⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧なので、⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦ほう→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Registration for the event starts at 9 a.m., so it's better to go early.

notes:
{受付|うけつけ} can refer to the reception desk, the receptionist, or the act of accepting/registering.

Derived from: ⟦{受|う}け{付|つ}ける→受け付ける：05683_uketsukeru⟧ (to accept, to receive)

Common collocations:
- {受付|うけつけ}で: at the reception desk
- {受付|うけつけ}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: reception hours
- {受付|うけつけ}⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧: start of registration
- {受付|うけつけ}⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}→終了：02563_shuuryou⟧: end of registration
- {受付|うけつけ}⟦{番号|ばんごう}→番号：02939_bangou⟧: reception number (ticket number)

Usage: Found in hospitals, hotels, offices, event venues, etc.
